name: Rear Pads
description: Rear pad compound is often one step less aggressive than the front to keep the rear stable on corner entry; matching compounds front/rear is the default starting point.

components.name: Rear brake pads (set per caliper)
components.description: Two pads per rear caliper. Change rear compound (lower mu) as a bias tool if the car is loose on entry and the bias bar is out of range.
